caption: The drawing features a single dark-colored teapot with a bulbous, rounded body, rendered in fine pencil or charcoal on a tan or off-white background. The teapot has three short legs at its base and a curved spout extending from the left side. The top opening is wide and lacks a lid. A large, arched handle is attached to the upper sides of the body, curving above the opening. The overall structure and form of the teapot are emphasized through shading and subtle highlights. The paper shows scattered brown spots and stains, particularly in the upper and right portions, which are part of the background and not the teapot itself. There is also a signature or label to the lower right of the teapot with the text "W SCHULT."
title: Cast Iron Tea Kettle
